verdict.rationale: Sentry documents ingesting both traces and logs via OTLP (sentry-docs-8/25) and offers a Trace Explorer to inspect span samples and attributes (sentry-docs-9), plus a Seer Agent that 'finds the right telemetry' to answer questions (sentry-docs-31), suggesting some cross-signal correlation. However, there is no explicit documentation of a UI workflow to jump directly from a specific span to its correlated logs and metrics in one click, and metrics support is not detailed at all in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit span-to-log/metric linking UI feature, first-party dashboard walkthrough, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this cross-navigation working in practice.
